item.title: 'Blow Out' Fire west of Amarillo in Potter County, 110 acres; 60% contained
item.description: Crews are working a grass fire west of Amarillo in the area of FM 2381, Legacy Ranch Road in Potter County.

item.title: AAA Texas: Gas prices increase as spring approaches
item.description: As reported by AAA Texas’ Weekend Gas Watch, the average gas price across Texas was $2.61per gallon for regular unleaded fuel on Thursday. This price is six cents more when compared to this day last week and 10 cents less compared to the same day last year.

item.title: WT Police report on-campus stalking incidents, domestic violence
item.description: West Texas A&M University officials reported on Thursday that campus police received a report of stalking incidents and domestic violence occurring on-campus in an administrative building.

item.title: Texas school districts approach crucial deadline for prayer policy
item.description: Texas school districts have until Saturday to vote whether they will adopt a resolution that would require each school to provide a period for prayer and reading religious texts for students and staff.

item.title: Family loses home in Ranger Road fire, begins long road to recovery
item.description: When flames from the Ranger Road fire moved toward their home, Trailen and Lacey Bond said they had little warning and only minutes to act.

item.title: Holy Cross wins TAPPS 2A state title
item.description: AMARILLO, Texas (KAMR/KCIT) - Holy Cross is on top of the state today after winning the TAPPS 2A state title. Here's the score from today: TAPPS 2A Holy Cross 59 Legacy Christian 45

item.title: Wildfires cause evacuations, impact traffic across the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma, Kansas
item.description: During critically dry and high-wind conditions on Tuesday, multiple wildfires sparked across communities in portions of the Texas Panhandle, Oklahoma and Kansas, causing a range of evacuations, warnings and road closures.
